titleEn: Range Sum of Sorted Subarray Sums
title: 子数组和排序后的区间和
summary: 计算所有连续非空子数组和，升序排序后返回第 left 到 right 项之和取模。
insight: 约束允许枚举 O(n²) 个子数组和；对每个起点向右累加即可生成，排序后汇总指定一基区间。
pitfalls: left 和 right 从一开始且包含端点

solutions.title: 枚举排序区间
solutions.idea: 显式生成所有连续子数组和。
steps: 对 start 枚举，sum=0，end 向右累加并加入 sums
排序 sums，累加索引 left-1..right-1 并取模

code.java: class Solution { public int rangeSum(int[] nums,int n,int left,int right){List<Integer> sums=new ArrayList<>();for(int start=0;start<n;start++){int sum=0;for(int end=start;end<n;end++){sum+=nums[end];sums.add(sum);}}Collections.sort(sums);long answer=0;for(int i=left-1;i<right;i++)answer+=sums.get(i);return (int)(answer%1_000_000_007L);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun rangeSum(nums:IntArray,n:Int,left:Int,right:Int):Int{val sums=mutableListOf<Int>();for(start in 0 until n){var sum=0;for(end in start until n){sum+=nums[end];sums.add(sum)}};sums.sort();var answer=0L;for(i in left-1 until right)answer+=sums[i];return (answer%1_000_000_007L).toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int rangeSum(vector<int>& nums,int n,int left,int right){vector<int> sums;for(int start=0;start<n;++start){int sum=0;for(int end=start;end<n;++end){sum+=nums[end];sums.push_back(sum);}}sort(sums.begin(),sums.end());long long answer=0;for(int i=left-1;i<right;++i)answer+=sums[i];return answer%1000000007;} };
